I have existential depression, or, logical depression. I will explain what I intend for that to mean, as well as my way of coping.

I firmly believe that life and living as a whole is an entirely fruitless, valueless, meaningless, and pathetic exercise in futility. I do not believe in any gods, dogmas, morals, ideals, authority, or traditions, as they are all abstractions and constructs we create as a comfortable psychological padding to protect us from the indifference of reality.

Generally speaking, I do not feel. Of course, given the right environment, exceptions are made, but my emotional spectrum is mostly limited to varying degrees of curiosity, fury and apathy. I am not depressed, at least, not in any conventional sense, nor do I mourn for my eventual demise. I see both activities as a poor use of my time. What's the point in worrying about when, how, and where l will lose all ability to react to impulse, when it is not only guaranteed, but the sensation of death itself is a fleeting and irreplicable experience that I will never recall?

I am not normal, and I probably never will be, but I find this mindset freeing in a way. There is no such thing as permanent satisfaction, existential validation, or post-mortem endgame, so why fucking try? The futility of the rat race is beneath me, I can find entertainment elsewhere.

Do I enjoy things? Sure, I have fun. I program, I skateboard, I run marathons, play video games, rant on the internet, race cars, have a somewhat lucrative job in the automotive field, etc. I do what I do, but not for any reason.

Am I happy? Fuck no. Happiness is the most fleeting and unsustainable state of being, and fuck anyone who claims to be happy all of the time, they are lying, stupid, or more dead inside than I am.

I did not ask to be born, and if I was, I would decline. I do not exactly enjoy living.
